topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I can't stop thinking about it. Every day, I'd see Mr. Johnson out in his garden, the same old lawn, same old clothes. I never imagined those drab suits and the modest sedan could hide so much. It was my daughter who spotted his name in the financial magazine, a major shareholder in a tech company. I feel like I've trespassed, peeking into his life. I thought about knocking on his door, maybe pretending I hadn't noticed, but the words stick in my throat. What do you say to someone after you've unknowingly judged them? I wish I could turn back time, back to when my assumptions were harmless, and I could look him in the eye without this new, uncomfortable knowledge.
